response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT ra.circuitId, c.country, ra.round FROM races ra JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = ra.circuitId), cc AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS circuit_avg FROM r GROUP BY circuitId, country), co AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_avg FROM r GROUP BY country) SELECT cc.circuitId, cc.country, cc.circuit_avg, cc.circuit_avg - co.country_avg AS diff FROM cc JOIN co ON co.country = cc.country ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
